workspace_settings.dashboard_source_of_truth_rule: The dashboard remains the source of truth for project lifecycle, required items, ownership, approvals, and communication state. Teams, SharePoint, Lists, and Planner are operational mirrors and collaboration surfaces only.
workspace_settings.read_only_mirror_fields_rule: Lifecycle, due, approval, and status fields may appear in Lists or Planner only as read-only mirrors sourced from dashboard IDs and sync timestamps.

sharepoint_architecture.site_strategy: One team-connected SharePoint site per department workspace, all associated to the internal operations hub site.

libraries.name: Project Documents
libraries.purpose: Controlled project and job support files tied back to dashboard records.

metadata_columns.notes: Primary dashboard object ID for every mirrored project or task document.
Expected values: job, task, organization, location, production_item.
Used for filtering and compliance scoping inside the department site.
Readable code mirror for operators; does not replace the dashboard ID.
Opens the canonical dashboard record from SharePoint and Teams tabs.

libraries.name: Templates and SOPs
libraries.purpose: Read-mostly department SOPs, templates, playbooks, and governed reusable assets.

metadata_columns.notes: Limits templates and SOP filters to the correct department workspace.
Named group owner for change control and review.
Used to manage live vs superseded SOP guidance.
Optional link back to the dashboard resource entry when one exists.

libraries.name: Approvals Archive
libraries.purpose: Attachment storage and record packets for governed approvals, never the approval state source of truth.

metadata_columns.notes: Canonical approval ID from the dashboard.
Links the approval document set back to the governed record.

libraries.name: Automation Working Files
libraries.purpose: Small controlled files that support governed flows and reports without becoming the workflow engine.

metadata_columns.notes: References the governing automation or diagnostics rule.
Scopes automation working files to the correct team.
Optional jump back to the governing dashboard diagnostics screen.

lists.name: Dashboard Projects
lists.purpose: Read-only mirror of active project and job coordination records for channel tabs and quick filtering.

fields.notes: Primary key mirrored from the dashboard.
Used to partition department team views.

lists.name: Dashboard Required Items
lists.purpose: Read-only mirror of required items and missing-readiness context for channel tabs and filters.

fields.notes: Canonical required item identity from the dashboard.
Parent record ID for the requirement.

lists.name: Dashboard Contacts
lists.purpose: Read-only mirror of operational contact context used by departments inside Teams and SharePoint.

fields.notes: Canonical contact ID from the dashboard.
Links the mirrored contact back to the parent organization.

lists.name: Dashboard Approvals
lists.purpose: Read-only approval mirror for the Approvals channel and governed review coordination.

fields.notes: Primary approval identifier from the dashboard.

lists.name: Dashboard Communication Events
lists.purpose: Readable mirror of communication actions and outcomes for Teams coordination and troubleshooting context.

fields.notes: Mirrored business object type for the communication.
Message send, meeting create, join, fail, and similar high-signal actions.
Opens the source-of-truth record or diagnostics view.

planner.plan_strategy: One Planner plan per department workspace, used as a coordination board for active department work rather than a second task system.
planner.task_source_rule: Create Planner tasks only for work that already has a dashboard ID and a meaningful department coordination reason. Every Planner task must include the dashboard ID in the title or description and a dashboard deep link in the references.
planner.ownership_rule: Primary task owner comes from the dashboard owner or assignee when one exists. If no individual owner exists, assign the department lead group for triage and preserve the dashboard record as the source of responsibility.
planner.completion_rule: Completing a Planner task does not complete the dashboard record. Planner completion only marks the collaboration card complete after the source-of-truth dashboard work is already handled or explicitly mirrored as handled.

buckets.name: Active This Week
buckets.purpose: Current active work with department execution underway.

buckets.name: Blocked / Escalated
buckets.purpose: Work requiring escalation, leadership, or cross-functional help.

buckets.name: Completed Recently
buckets.purpose: Short-lived completion bucket before archival cleanup or automatic removal.

execution_order.title: Approve Phase 2 workspace topology and naming conventions
execution_order.rollback: Reject the baseline and do not provision any new teams, sites, or lists.

execution_order.title: Create or validate the SharePoint operations hub site and department workspace naming prefix
execution_order.rollback: Remove the hub association and revert new site naming before content migration.

execution_order.title: Provision one pilot department team-connected site and Planner plan from the reusable template
execution_order.rollback: Archive the pilot team/site/plan and clear its group memberships.

execution_order.title: Create the standard read-only Microsoft Lists mirrors with dashboard ID fields first
execution_order.rollback: Delete the pilot lists and remove corresponding tabs before broader rollout.

execution_order.title: Add standard Teams tabs and dashboard deep links to the pilot department channels
execution_order.rollback: Remove the pilot tabs and restore the default channel tab set.

execution_order.title: Validate Planner ownership and read-only mirror rules with department leads
execution_order.rollback: Disable Planner usage for that department until ownership rules are corrected.

execution_order.title: Roll the template across remaining departments after pilot validation
execution_order.rollback: Stop rollout after the last healthy department and keep non-migrated departments on the old structure.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Confirm Phase 1 security/governance validation is clean for the target environment.
Create or validate the operations hub site URL and department site naming standard.
Provision the pilot department team and connect it to the matching SharePoint site.
Create the standard document libraries and metadata columns in the pilot workspace.
Create the five read-only mirror lists using the baseline field definitions.
Create the department Planner plan and standard buckets.
Add the standard tabs and dashboard links to each default channel in the pilot team.

validation_checklist: Confirm every list item, folder, or Planner card created from the template stores a dashboard ID and deep link.
Confirm Lists and Planner do not introduce editable lifecycle truth that conflicts with dashboard workflow state.
Confirm the pilot department can navigate from Teams tabs back to the correct dashboard screens.
Confirm SharePoint libraries and metadata columns support read-only filtering and document lookup without duplicating record ownership.
Confirm all departments can reuse the same channel, tab, library, list, and bucket structure with only naming differences.
rollback_principles: Roll back by department workspace, not tenant-wide, so unaffected departments keep working.
Remove or archive pilot tabs, lists, and plans before deleting the connected team or site.
Do not migrate existing business files into the new structure until pilot validation is complete.
Never preserve a mirror list or Planner board without its dashboard ID fields and deep links.
